events.summary: As development continues on the new third-person 3D version of GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown, we want the villages along your journey to feel like places with their own purpose and daily life—not just scenery between destinations. A Smithy You Can See from the Road Our latest work brings a smithy into the village landscape, where we can now inspect it directly from the normal third-person gameplay view. events.title: Developing the Adventurers' Guild and Quest Board
events.summary: In GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown, we are not only working on third-person 3D exploration and battles. We are also building the systems that connect villages, roads, and the people living in the world to the player's next objective. This update focuses on the Adventurers' Guild and the quest board. events.title: Integrating the Foundation of the Third-Person 3D Version into Main
events.summary: This update integrates a new foundation for the third-person 3D version of GEKOKUJO into the main GitHub branch. This does not mean the game is finished. It means that several parts of the current third-person field, Party travel, Wolf Companion, environments, UI, and motion work have been organized as a foundation for the road toward Early Access. events.title: Traveling as a Party — Improving Companion Movement and Formation
events.summary: In the new third-person field, we are working on a travel system that makes the protagonist, Party Members, and Wolf Companion feel like a group moving through the world together. KEEPING THE PARTY TOGETHER Our earlier companion movement was largely based on following fixed positions around the player. events.title: NPCs Who Keep Living Beyond the Player's View — Pseudo-Players and Rumors
events.summary: We do not want the world of GEKOKUJO to be filled with NPCs who simply stand still and wait for the player. Even when they are outside the player's view, characters should continue pursuing their own goals, making choices, and leaving behind a personal history. This update introduces two systems supporting that vision: pseudo-player NPCs and rumors. NPCs with Dreams and Goals Some NPCs have long-term dreams as well as shorter goals. events.title: Walking, Running, and Traveling Together in the New 3D Field
events.summary: In the new third-person field of GEKOKUJO, we are continuing to improve both character movement and the experience of traveling with companions. From a third-person perspective, even small issues become much easier to notice: feet sliding across the ground, mismatched movement speed, awkward turns, or unnatural poses on slopes.
